about: v84k skill bar (js/ab-skillbar.js, js/ab-hudarc.js, js/ab-skilltree.js). hud.order: leftToRight puts HUD slot 1 (#skill-0, hotkey 1) leftmost and slot 4 rightmost, matching the 1-4 picker in the skill screen; 'arc' keeps the old angle order. respec: the skill screen's Hold to respec refunds tree points only (stats, gear and non-tree buffs stay); costPerLevel x level gold, same as before. rememberBar puts each skill back in the slot it had once it is learned again. cooldown: the overlay on each HUD skill button. Colours are CSS colours; sizes are CSS px; times in ms or s as named.

respec.toast: Tree points refunded. Your stats and gear stay.
